+            residual = layer.mhc_post(x, residual, post_mix, res_mix)
+            hashes = engram_hashes[:, layer.engram.layer_hash_index]
+            residual = layer.engram(residual, hashes, engram_mask)
+            fold = False
+        md = cast("dict[str, Any]", get_forward_context().attn_metadata)
+        swa = md[cast("str", plan.swa_key)]
+        kw: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        if plan.index:
+            kw["select"] = lambda normed, qr: _select(layer, positions, normed, qr)
+        if plan.ratio:
+            comp = md[cast("str", plan.comp_key)]
+            kw.update(
+                topk_indices=attn.topk_indices_buffer,
+                comp_cache=_record_view(
+                    attn._compressed_kv_cache(), comp.block_size // plan.ratio
+                ),
+                comp_block_table=comp.block_table,
+            )
+        return runner.forward(
+            plan.weights,
+            x,
+            residual,
+            post_mix,
+            res_mix,
+            pre_mix,
+            positions,
+            swa.slot_mapping,
+            _record_view(attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache, swa.block_size),
+            swa.decode_swa_indices,
+            swa.decode_swa_lens,
+            swa.token_to_req_indices,
+            fold=fold,
+            **kw,
+        )
+
+    def launch_ffn(
+        self,
+        plan: LayerPlan,
+        part: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        post_mix: torch.Tensor,
+        res_mix: torch.Tensor,
+        pre_mix: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None:
+        """The FFN seam, MoE and both reductions as one launch, from wo_b's
+        unreduced output after vLLM's attention."""
+        tensors = (part, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix)
+        if not all(t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors):
+            return None
+        return self.runner.ffn(plan.weights, *tensors, topk=self.topk)
+
+
+class DSV41Kernel(LayerLaunches):
+    """The backbone's decode: 384 experts, top-6, causal SWA windows."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model, widths: tuple[int, ...]):
+        super().__init__(
+            vllm_config,
+            model,
+            widths,
+            experts=EXPERTS,
+            topk=TOPK,
+            ug_groups=UG_GROUPS,
+            swa_width=SWA_WIDTH,
+        )
+
+    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any:
+        model, positions = self.model, step.positions
+        (
+            hidden,
+            input_ids,
+            pre_mix,
+            engram_hashes,
+            engram_mask,
+            full_num_tokens,
+        ) = model.prologue(
+            input_ids, positions, None, inputs_embeds, kwargs.get("lookback_token_ids")
+        )
+        residual = post_mix = res_mix = None
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        final_aux_recon = None
+        for idx in range(self.embed_layer, self.layer_end):
+            layer = model.layers[idx]
+            plan = self.plans.get(layer.attn.layer_id)
+            ffn = out = None
+            if plan is None:
+                # TODO: check if we should crash here
+                pass
+            elif plan.ffn_only:
+                ffn = partial(self.launch_ffn, plan)
+            else:
+                # Run entire layer
+                out = self.launch_whole(
+                    plan,
+                    hidden,
+                    positions,
+                    residual,
+                    post_mix,
+                    res_mix,
+                    pre_mix,
+                    engram_hashes,
+                    engram_mask,
+                )
+            if out is None:
+                # Run standard model implementation, with injected specialized ffn
+                out = layer(
+                    hidden,
+                    positions,
+                    input_ids,
+                    pre_mix,
+                    post_mix,
+                    res_mix,
+                    residual,
+                    engram_hashes,
+                    engram_mask,
+                    decode_ffn=ffn,
+                )
+            hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix = out
+            aux_recon = model.after_layer(
+                idx,
+                hidden,
+                residual,
+                post_mix,
+                res_mix,
+                full_num_tokens,
+                aux_hidden_states,
+                replay=False,
+            )
+            if aux_recon is not None:
+                final_aux_recon = aux_recon
+        return model.epilogue(
+            hidden,
+            positions,
+            input_ids,
+            pre_mix,
+            post_mix,
+            res_mix,
+            residual,
+            aux_hidden_states,
+            final_aux_recon,
+            self.layer_end > self.embed_layer,
+            full_num_tokens,
+            replay=False,
+        )
+
+
+class DSV41DraftKernel(LayerLaunches):
+    """The DSpark draft's decode: the draft's own routing and non-causal SWA
+    rows, over the draft head's layers."""
+
+    draft = True
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model, widths: tuple[int, ...]):
+        experts, topk = draft_routing(vllm_config)
+        super().__init__(
+            vllm_config,
+            model,
+            widths,
+            experts=experts,
+            topk=topk,
+            # the draft's unions are small on gfx950, where it runs whole; on
+            # gfx942 it takes the FFN launch, validated at the target's groups
+            ug_groups=UG_GROUPS if on_gfx942() else DRAFT_UG_GROUPS,
+            swa_width=draft_swa_width(vllm_config),
+        )
+
+    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any:
+        model, positions = self.model, step.positions
+        hidden, input_ids, full_num_tokens = model.prologue(
+            input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds
+        )
+        residual = post_mix = res_mix = pre_mix = None
+        for idx in range(self.embed_layer, self.layer_end):
+            layer = model.layers[idx]
+            plan = self.plans.get(layer.attn.layer_id)
+            ffn = out = None
+            if plan is None:
+                pass
+            elif plan.ffn_only:
+                ffn = partial(self.launch_ffn, plan)
+            else:
+                out = self.launch_whole(
+                    plan, hidden, positions, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix
+                )
+            if out is None:
+                out = layer(
+                    hidden,
+                    positions,
+                    input_ids,
+                    pre_mix,
+                    post_mix,
+                    res_mix,
+                    residual,
+                    decode_ffn=ffn,
+                )
+            hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix = out
+        return model.epilogue(
+            hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix, full_num_tokens
+        )
+
+
+def prepare_weights(vllm_config, model, draft: bool = False) -> None:
+    """Make ready, at model creation, whatever the launches need from the
+    weights before vLLM loads them: the flag the gfx942 decode helpers read, the
+    top-k hooks they call, and the gfx942 kernels' own copies of the weights,
+    which vLLM then makes as it processes each layer's at load.
+
+    Args:
+        vllm_config: the config of the model being created.
+        model: the backbone, or the DSpark draft head's.
+        draft: whether ``model`` is the draft head's backbone.
+
+    """
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd import ops
+
+    # The gfx942 decode helpers run in forward passes, where vLLM's current
+    # config is not set, so they read the flag recorded here.
+    ops.record_specialized_decode(vllm_config)
+    if not vllm_config.kernel_config.specialized_decode or not on_gfx942():
+        return
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.ops import topk as topk_ops
+
+    from .weights942 import copy_at_load
+
+    # A failed build shows at startup, and the hooks then leave the top-k to
+    # vLLM from the first step on.
+    topk_ops.build()
+    experts, topk = draft_routing(vllm_config) if draft else (EXPERTS, TOPK)
+    tp_size = vllm_config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
+    for layer in model.layers:
+        if _skip_layer(layer, experts, topk, tp_size) is None:
+            copy_at_load(layer, ffn_only=draft or _ffn_only(layer) is not None)
+
+
+def _ffn_only(layer) -> str | None:
+    """Why this layer's attention seam and attention stay on vLLM's path, which
+    leaves it the FFN launch, or None when it runs whole."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.rocm import DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.attention import DeepseekV4Indexer
+
+    # The MXFP4 indexer cache needs CDNA4, so gfx942 drives vLLM's FP8 indexer,
+    # whose wq_b also reads K1's bf16 qr.
+    indexer_cls = DeepseekV4Indexer if on_gfx942() else DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer
+    attn = layer.attn
+    if attn.compressor is not None and attn.indexer is None:
+        return "a compressor without an indexer"
+    if attn.indexer is not None and not isinstance(attn.indexer, indexer_cls):
+        return f"a {type(attn.indexer).__name__}"
+    if attn.compress_ratio not in (0, 1, 2):
+        return f"compress ratio {attn.compress_ratio}"
+    if attn.kv_mxfp8 or attn.kv_cache_dtype != "fp8_ds_mla":
+        return f"a {attn.kv_cache_dtype} KV cache"
+    return None
+
+
+def _skip_layer(layer, experts: int, topk: int, tp_size: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why this layer keeps vLLM's path for every step, or None when it takes a
+    launch (whole or FFN only: ``_plan_layer`` picks which)."""
+    ffn = layer.ffn
+    gfx942 = on_gfx942()
+    if layer.use_sequence_parallel:
+        return "sequence-parallel layer"
+    if not layer.fuse_seam_norm and not gfx942:
+        # gfx942 has no fused seam kernel. vLLM rounds the collapsed stream to
+        # bf16 before its RMSNorm there, which the kernels' fused seam does not,
+        # so the two paths differ by that rounding.
+        return "needs aiter's fused mHC seam"
+    if gfx942 and tp_size != 4:
+        return "gfx942 builds for tensor parallel size 4 only"
+    if (
+        ffn.shared_experts is None
+        or ffn.gate.tid2eid is not None
+        or ffn.n_routed_experts != experts
+        or ffn.n_activated_experts != topk
+        or ffn.routed_scaling_factor != 1.5
+        or ffn.swiglu_limit != 10.0
+        or ffn.scoring_func != "sqrtsoftplus"
+        or not ffn.renormalize
+    ):
+        return (
+            f"MoE routing outside the kernels' ({experts} / {topk}, sqrtsoftplus, x1.5)"
+        )
+    return None
+
+
+def _weights(layer, ffn_only: bool, world: int, experts: int):
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.mono.runner import (
+        MonoLayerWeights,
+    )
+
+    if on_gfx942():
+        from .weights942 import layer_weights
+
+        return layer_weights(layer, ffn_only, world)
+    a, f = layer.attn, layer.ffn
+    e, sh = f.experts.routed_experts, f.shared_experts
+    weights = MonoLayerWeights(
+        attn=None if ffn_only else _attn_weights(a, world),
+        hc_attn_fn=layer.hc_attn_fn,
+        hc_attn_scale=layer.hc_attn_scale,
+        hc_attn_base=layer.hc_attn_base,
+        attn_norm=layer.attn_norm.weight,
+        hc_ffn_fn=layer.hc_ffn_fn,
+        hc_ffn_scale=layer.hc_ffn_scale,
+        hc_ffn_base=layer.hc_ffn_base,
+        ffn_norm=layer.ffn_norm.weight,
+        gate_w=f.gate.weight,
+        bias=f.gate.e_score_correction_bias,
+        w13=e.w13_weight,
+        w13_s=e.w13_weight_scale,
+        w2=e.w2_weight,
+        w2_s=e.w2_weight_scale,
+        sgu=sh.gate_up_proj.weight,
+        sgu_s=_scale_bytes(sh.gate_up_proj.weight_scale),
+        sw2=sh.down_proj.weight,
+        sw2_s=_scale_bytes(sh.down_proj.weight_scale),
+    )
+    weights.check(world, experts)
+    return weights
+
+
+def _attn_weights(a, world: int):
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.mono.attention.plan import Dims
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.mono.runner import AttnWeights
+
+    attn = AttnWeights(
+        layer_id=a.layer_id,
+        wqkv=a.fused_wqa_wkv.weight,
+        wqkv_scale=_scale_bytes(a.fused_wqa_wkv.weight_scale),
+        q_norm=a.q_norm.weight,
+        kv_norm=a.kv_norm.weight,
+        wq_b=a.wq_b.weight,
+        wq_b_scale=_scale_bytes(a.wq_b.weight_scale),
+        wo_a=a.wo_a.weight,
+        wo_a_scale=_scale_bytes(a.wo_a.weight_scale),
+        wo_b=a.wo_b.weight,
+        wo_b_scale=_scale_bytes(a.wo_b.weight_scale),
+        attn_sink=a.attn_sink,
+        cos_sin=a.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+        ratio=a.compress_ratio,
+    )
+    attn.check(Dims(world))
+    return attn

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The gfx942 kernels' own copies of a decoder layer's weights.
+
+On CDNA3 the kernels compute the same layer with FNUZ FP8 MFMAs, from tensors
+re-encoded as they read them (``mono/weights942.py``). The copies are made as
+vLLM processes the loaded weights, so that they count as model memory when vLLM
+sizes the KV cache: copies made at the first decode step would count only when
+that step is also the CUDA graph memory profile.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from ..spec import INTER_TP4
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer
+
+# the attention linears the kernels read as ``linear_copy`` copies, as names of
+# the layer's attention module
+ATTN_LINEARS = ("fused_wqa_wkv", "wq_b", "wo_a", "wo_b")
+
+
+def scale_bytes(scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return scale if scale.dtype == torch.uint8 else scale.view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _keep(layer, copies: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]) -> None:
+    """Store a layer's copies as ``layer.mono942``. A reload of the weights
+    runs ``process_weights_after_loading`` again, and the kernels and captured
+    CUDA graphs read the first copies by their addresses, so a reload's copies
+    are written into the first ones in place."""
+    kept = getattr(layer, "mono942", None)
+    if kept is None:
+        layer.mono942 = copies
+        return
+    for old, new in zip(kept, copies, strict=True):
+        old.copy_(new)
+
+
+def _capture_plain_experts(experts) -> None:
+    """Take the copies before vLLM converts the routed experts to its Triton kernels'
+    format when the weights are loaded, which frees the plain scales."""
+    qm = experts.quant_method
+    original = qm.process_weights_after_loading
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(layer):
+        if layer is experts:
+            from ...mono.weights942 import moe_copies
+
+            _keep(
+                layer,
+                moe_copies(
+                    layer.w13_weight.data,
+                    scale_bytes(layer.w13_weight_scale.data),
+                    layer.w2_weight.data,
+                    scale_bytes(layer.w2_weight_scale.data),
+                    INTER_TP4,
+                ),
+            )
+        return original(layer)
+
+    qm.process_weights_after_loading = process_weights_after_loading
+
+
+def _copy_linear(linear) -> None:
+    """By default (VLLM_MXFP8_EMULATION_DEQUANT_AT_LOAD) vLLM dequantizes a
+    dense MXFP8 linear's weights to bf16, and the copy re-encodes them as the
+    kernels read them. Weights that stay e4m3 are copied as they are."""
+    qm = linear.quant_method
+    original = qm.process_weights_after_loading
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(layer):
+        out = original(layer)
+        if layer is linear:
+            from ...mono.weights942 import linear_copy
+
+            _keep(layer, linear_copy(layer.weight, layer.weight_scale))
+        return out
+
+    qm.process_weights_after_loading = process_weights_after_loading
+
+
+def copy_at_load(layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer", ffn_only: bool) -> None:
+    """Make this layer's copies when vLLM processes its weights at load. A
+    layer that takes only the FFN launch needs no attention copies."""
+    ffn = layer.ffn
+    _capture_plain_experts(ffn.experts.routed_experts)
+    sh = ffn.shared_experts
+    assert sh is not None
+    linears = [sh.gate_up_proj, sh.down_proj]
+    if not ffn_only:
+        linears += [getattr(layer.attn, name) for name in ATTN_LINEARS]
+    for linear in linears:
+        _copy_linear(linear)
+
+
+def layer_weights(layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer", ffn_only: bool, world: int):
+    """The layer's tensors as the gfx942 kernels read them: the dense MXFP8
+    linears and the routed experts as the copies made at load."""
+    from ...mono.runner import MonoLayerWeights
+
+    f = layer.ffn
+    e, sh = f.experts.routed_experts, f.shared_experts
+    assert sh is not None
+    w13, w13_s, w2, w2_s = e.mono942
+    sgu, sgu_s = sh.gate_up_proj.mono942
+    sw2, sw2_s = sh.down_proj.mono942
+    weights = MonoLayerWeights(
+        attn=None if ffn_only else _attn_weights(layer.attn, world),
+        hc_attn_fn=layer.hc_attn_fn,
+        hc_attn_scale=layer.hc_attn_scale,
+        hc_attn_base=layer.hc_attn_base,
+        attn_norm=layer.attn_norm.weight,
+        hc_ffn_fn=layer.hc_ffn_fn,
+        hc_ffn_scale=layer.hc_ffn_scale,
+        hc_ffn_base=layer.hc_ffn_base,
+        ffn_norm=layer.ffn_norm.weight,
+        gate_w=f.gate.weight,
+        bias=f.gate.e_score_correction_bias,
+        w13=w13,
+        w13_s=w13_s,
+        w2=w2,
+        w2_s=w2_s,
+        sgu=sgu,
+        sgu_s=sgu_s,
+        sw2=sw2,
+        sw2_s=sw2_s,
+    )
+    weights.check_942(f.n_routed_experts)
+    return weights
+
+
+def _attn_weights(a, world: int):
+    from ...mono.attention.plan import Dims
+    from ...mono.runner import AttnWeights
+
+    wqkv, wq_b, wo_a, wo_b = (getattr(a, name).mono942 for name in ATTN_LINEARS)
+    attn = AttnWeights(
+        layer_id=a.layer_id,
+        wqkv=wqkv[0],
+        wqkv_scale=wqkv[1],
+        q_norm=a.q_norm.weight,
+        kv_norm=a.kv_norm.weight,
+        wq_b=wq_b[0],
+        wq_b_scale=wq_b[1],
+        wo_a=wo_a[0],
+        wo_a_scale=wo_a[1],
+        wo_b=wo_b[0],
+        wo_b_scale=wo_b[1],
+        attn_sink=a.attn_sink,
+        cos_sin=a.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+        ratio=a.compress_ratio,
+    )
+    attn.check(Dims(world))
+    return attn

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1's specialized decode."""
+
+import functools
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast
+
+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.spec import DecodeSpec, Feature
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.rocm import DeepseekV41ROCMAiterSparseSWAMetadata
+
+    from .runtime.decode import DSV41DraftKernel, DSV41Kernel, LayerLaunches
+
+RECORD = 584  # an fp8_ds_mla KV record: 576 data bytes, 8 scale bytes
+SWA_WIDTH = 128  # a causal decode token's window slots
+MAX_ROWS = 48  # the kernels' step rows at most: 8 requests x (1 + 5 DSpark drafts)
+# A gfx942 workgroup has 64 KB of LDS, not 160 KB as on gfx950. Its kernels take
+# a step's tokens 6 at a time (mono.stages.gemv.TILE), and at TP 4 they take up
+# to 7 requests with 5 DSpark drafts each. A larger step runs vLLM's path.
+MAX_ROWS_GFX942 = 42
+EXPERTS = 384  # the backbone's routed experts, top-TOPK of them a token
+TOPK = 6
+# FP4 groups of an ug task
+UG_GROUPS = 2
+# the draft's 128-expert unions are small
+DRAFT_UG_GROUPS = 1
+# the kernels' ISA: CDNA4 (gfx950) scaled MFMA and MX formats, or CDNA3
+# (gfx942), where the kernels compute the same layer with FNUZ FP8 MFMAs on
+# their own copies of the weights (runtime/weights942.py)
+CDNA_VERSIONS = (3, 4)
+# the routed experts' intermediate width a rank at TP 4 (2304 / 4): vLLM pads it
+# to 640 on gfx942, and the gfx942 copies keep only the real columns
+INTER_TP4 = 576
+
+
+def on_gfx942() -> bool:
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    return get_cdna_version() == 3
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def max_rows() -> int:
+    """The widest step the kernels take on this GPU."""
+    return MAX_ROWS_GFX942 if on_gfx942() else MAX_ROWS
+
+
+def draft_routing(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """The DSpark draft's routed experts and top-k (128 / 3 on V4.1-Flash)."""
+    config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+    return (
+        getattr(config, "dspark_n_routed_experts", 0) or EXPERTS,
+        getattr(config, "dspark_num_experts_per_tok", 0) or TOPK,
+    )
+
+
+def draft_swa_width(vllm_config) -> int:
+    """The DSpark draft's SWA rows: a block's non-causal window, not a causal
+    decode token's."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.compressor_utils import (
+        get_dspark_swa_index_width,
+    )
+
+    config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+    speculative = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    assert speculative is not None
+    return get_dspark_swa_index_width(
+        config.sliding_window, speculative.num_speculative_tokens
+    )
+
+
+def _widths(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """The configured capture sizes the kernels can serve, so a deployment
+    that asked for fewer graphs keeps them; every size at all when it asked for
+    none."""
+    rows = max_rows()
+    sizes = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or []
+    served = tuple(s for s in sorted(sizes) if 1 <= s <= rows)
+    return served or tuple(range(1, rows + 1))
+
+
+def _draft_widths(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """A draft step's rows: one block of draft tokens a request, so multiples of
+    the block rather than the target's capture sizes.
+
+    Intuitively [block, 2*block, ..., seqs*block or max_rows]
+    """
+    speculative = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    assert speculative is not None
+    block = speculative.num_speculative_tokens
+    seqs = vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
+    return tuple(range(block, min(block * seqs, max_rows()) + 1, block))

+    props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())

+        reasons.append("needs tensor parallel size 2, 4 or 8")
+    if envs.VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4:
+        reasons.append(
+            "needs AITER's A8W4 MoE (VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4 unset)"
+        )
+    try:
+        import vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.mono.runner  # noqa: F401
+    except ImportError as err:
+        reasons.append(f"needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers ({err})")
+    return reasons

+    kernels read every one of the 384 experts on each rank, TP-sharded, in
+    AITER's A8W4 MXFP4 layout, from CTAs that all stay resident."""

+    )

+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version

+    the block holds, or the next block starts inside it.

+    asks for them, which the runner can only scale up, so this is the floor;
+    ``_record_view`` settles each step against the block size it is given.

+    """Why this step keeps vLLM's path at every layer, or None when the kernels
+    take it. One verdict for every kernel layer, from the batch the whole TP
+    group sees alike."""
+    md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    if not decode.plans:
+        return "no layer takes a launch"
+    if not isinstance(md, dict):  # a profile / dummy run, or DBO ubatches
+        return "no attention metadata"
+    replay = decode.model.decoder_replay_layers
+    if replay is not None and replay.uses_replay_batch():
+        return "replay batch step"
+    if any(md.get(k) is None for k in decode.comp_keys):
+        return "layer metadata missing"
+    return _skip_swa(decode, md, width)
+
+
+def _skip_draft_step(vllm_config, decode: "DSV41DraftKernel", width: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why this draft step keeps vLLM's path at every layer. The draft reads no
+    compressed keys and never runs a replay batch, so its SWA rows decide it."""
+    md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    if not decode.plans:
+        return "no draft layer takes a launch"
+    if not isinstance(md, dict):  # a profile / dummy run, or DBO ubatches
+        return "no attention metadata"
+    return _skip_swa(decode, md, width)
+

+    from .runtime.decode import DSV41Kernel
+
+    return DSV41Kernel(vllm_config, model, widths)
+
+
+def _build_draft(vllm_config, model, widths: tuple[int, ...]) -> "DSV41DraftKernel":
+    from .runtime.decode import DSV41DraftKernel
+
+    return DSV41DraftKernel(vllm_config, model, widths)
+

+_SUPPORTS = frozenset({Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL, Feature.SPECULATIVE_DECODING})
+
+DECODE_SPEC = DecodeSpec["DSV41Kernel"](
+    name="dsv41-cdna4",
+    supports=_SUPPORTS,
+    widths=_widths,
+    refuse_config=_refuse_config,
+    refuse_model=_refuse_model,
+    refuse_caches=_refuse_caches,
+    skip_step=_skip_step,
+    build=_build,

+
+DRAFT_DECODE_SPEC = DecodeSpec["DSV41DraftKernel"](
+    name="dsv41-dspark-cdna4",
+    supports=_SUPPORTS,
+    widths=_draft_widths,
+    set_capture_sizes=False,

+    refuse_model=_refuse_model,
+    refuse_caches=_refuse_caches,
+    skip_step=_skip_draft_step,
+    build=_build_draft,
+)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The layout every MonoKernel's error words and fault hook follow.
+
+A rank's health words: a header whose word FAILED is set once any of its
+in-kernel waits gave up (sticky: a failed rank stays failed, and its later waits
+exit at once), then one record a CTA of the first wait it gave up on (flag,
+region id, pair index, tag, seen tag, CTA, clock, pad).
+
+The output rank's flags: one int32 word a TP rank in the first PEER_HEAD bytes
+of the output rank's peer buffer. A rank whose wait gives up writes its word
+there, drains the store, then sets FAILED, so nothing it stores later can
+overtake the flag. The runner reads these words after every step.
+"""
+
+MONO_ABI_VERSION = 1
+
+RECORD_WORDS = 8
+FAILED = 0
+PEER_HEAD = 256

+        Feature.ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE: (

+        ),

+        Feature.CPU_WEIGHT_OFFLOAD: (
+            oc.uva.cpu_offload_gb > 0 or oc.prefetch.offload_group_size > 0
+        ),
+        Feature.WEIGHT_UPDATES: vllm_config.weight_transfer_config is not None,
+    }

+def refuse_config(spec: MonoSpec, vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this config cannot run ``spec``: default-deny on features,
+    then the runner and the graph mode, then the spec's own."""
+    reasons = [
+        f"{f.value} is not supported"
+        for f in sorted(features_in_use(vllm_config) - spec.supports)
+    ]
+    if not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner:
+        reasons.append("needs Model Runner V2")
+    mode = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode
+    if mode is not None and mode not in _FULL_MODES:
+        reasons.append(f"CUDA graph mode {mode.name}: decode needs FULL graphs")
+    return reasons + list(spec.refuse_config(vllm_config))

+
+def refuse_model(spec: MonoSpec, model) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason the loaded model cannot run ``spec``. A MonoKernel replaces
+    the layer loop, which a traced graph has already inlined, so a model
+    carrying ``@support_torch_compile`` is refused."""
+    from vllm.compilation.wrapper import TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper
+
+    reasons = []

+            "so the model must not carry @support_torch_compile"

+    """The first variant this config can serve, and every variant's refusals.

+        ``refusals`` holds each variant's reasons, by spec name.

+def refused(refusals: dict[str, list[str]]) -> str:

+            normed, comp.fused_wkv_wgate.weight.T, out_dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        latent = comp(kv_score, positions)
+        comp.insert_cache(latent, positions, attn.rotary_emb)
+        indexer._produce_k(latent, positions, attn.indexer_rotary_emb)
+    weights, _ = indexer.weights_proj(normed)
+    q, q_scale, weights = indexer.forward_q(
+        qr, None, weights, positions, attn.indexer_rotary_emb
+    )
+    assert weights is not None
+    indexer.indexer_op(
+        normed, (q, q_scale) if q_scale is not None else q, None, weights
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LaunchState:
+    """What this rank's launches hold across every step: the runner (one a
+    rank, its peer memory collective over the TP group), the error words, each
+    kernel layer's weight views, and the metadata keys ``skip_step`` validates
+    for every kernel layer at once.
+
+    Built once at attach and never moved: the kernels and the captured graphs
+    hold its addresses.
+    """
+
+    runner: Any
+    embed_layer: int
+    words: torch.Tensor

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

One check needs to come back. `_record_view` treats the KV cache as `[blocks, block, RECORD]` and steps to the next block with `kv.stride(0)`. That stride has to be at least `block * RECORD`, or the next block starts inside the current one. `refuse_caches` only checks `stride(0) < RECORD`. Please validate `kv.stride(0) >= block * RECORD` before creating the view.

On MI350 the monokernel ITL matches main. The tok/s gaps follow acceptance on a short random bench. GSM8K and GPQA stay within stderr.
It's better to add the introduction/tutorial in the PR body into https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/main/docs/design.

In my opinion, this PR leans a bit too far on the side of generalizing interfaces. I think a lot of this code is just "unification for the sake of it" that tries to enumerate every possible case and provide a generic base implementation, instead of just providing a common interface that models can implement according to their own needs.
